# Degree Credit
For the 2026–2027 Emory College catalog, the BA and BS require 124 academic credits, plus two physical education credits and one personal health course.
# GER Entry Cohorts
Students entering in fall 2022 or earlier follow the Gold (2009) general education requirements. Students entering in fall 2023 or later follow the Blue (2023) general education requirements.
# Majors and Minors
Students need a major; a minor is optional. A student may pursue one major, two majors, or one major with a minor. The catalog states a 2.0 average is required in the major and in a minor, when applicable.
# Declaration Timing
First-year students declare after their first semester. ECAS first-years should declare by their fourth regular semester; Oxford graduates by their first regular ECAS semester; transfer students by their second. Students who have completed 90 hours need approval to add or change a major.
